title: CRISP Tool – SCP Digitalization
summary: A system-driven, integrated digital platform that automates Price Change Calculation (PCR) and Sales, Controlling & Planning (SCP) workflows, bringing transparency, consistency, and governance to contract management.
impact: 100% traceability of price & volume changes | Eliminated Excel-based processes
problem: CMD and SCP processes for price change calculation (PCR) and volume planning were managed through manual, Excel-based workflows. This led to limited end-to-end visibility across Contracts, Plans (TBP/CF), and Actuals, high manual effort and dependency on individual knowledge, inconsistent and non-repeatable PCR and volume calculations, delays in TBP and CF cycles, and limited auditability and explainability of price and volume deviations.
solution: CRISP is a system-driven, integrated digital platform that automates PCR and SCP workflows. It introduces a structured Plan vs Actual explanation framework (Target Cross) to clearly separate and explain price and volume deviations. The platform includes modules for Master Data Management (MDM), Parts Management, Contract Management (Forex, RMI, Energy, Volumes), Purchase Orders, Reconciliations with approval workflows, and Forecasting with CF cycle support.

modules.name: Parts
modules.description: Customer Code, Import Content, Materials, Energy, Discounts (Volume/YoY/Combined bands), Contracts

modules.name: Contracts
modules.description: Engine Model, Parts, Forex, RMI, Energy — each with Contract Conditions, Threshold/Burden Share, Base Rates & Source; Volumes, Reference Documents

modules.name: Purchase Orders
modules.description: Full CRUD operations for PO management

modules.name: Reconciliations
modules.description: Rates (Forex, Material, Energy), Schedules, Parts Approval Workflow (Pending Approvals → PO → GPM → History)

modules.name: Forecasting
modules.description: Schedules (CF Cycles/Year), CF Cycles with Manual Override, Download Price Forecasting Excel

users: Sales KAMs, SCP-IN team, PS-IN/RGB, rBUs, CTG-IN
results: Digitized and automated end-to-end CMD and SCP workflows, eliminating Excel-based processes
Seamless traceability: Contracts (Quotation, LOI, PO) → Plan (TBP, CF) → Actuals (YEC, POE billing prices)
System-driven PCR and volume forecast calculations ensuring consistency and accuracy
Clear ownership and accountability for pricing, planning, and volume data
Improved forecast accuracy and faster decision-making through reliable, timely, and explainable insights
Reduced planning cycle times and manual effort across TBP and CF cycles
successCriteria: 100% traceability of price and volume changes across Contracts, Plans, Bottom Line, and Actuals
Consistent, explainable, and auditable PCR calculations with full audit trails
Measurable improvement in productivity and efficiency
High adoption and sustained usage by CMD and SCP teams
Single, trusted version of Target Cross outputs for reviews and decision-making
